decisions.reason: KiCad-version-specific 3D model path references do not change BOM completeness, part-number, or assembly-readiness requirements.
Changing how packaged 3D models are referenced does not alter component availability, sourcing, or JLCPCB Basic-component preferences.
The source decision concerns portable KiCad model references, not how PCB assembly orders are configured in JLCPCB.
The requirement to validate placement orientation in JLCPCB remains unchanged; the source only addresses KiCad 3D-model path portability.
KiCad library path compatibility does not change the requirement to place QR identification on every board.
The integrated board's through-hole connector mounting choice is unaffected by 3D-model reference paths.
The lead-free manufacturing constraint remains valid unchanged and is unrelated to KiCad-version-specific library variables.
The required Gerber, drill, and pick-and-place exports are unchanged; the source decision applies specifically to packaged 3D-model references.
Connector pin labeling and its board location are unaffected by KiCad 8 versus KiCad 9 third-party path variables.
The power board's dimensions, orientation, mounting holes, and connector clearances do not change because of portable 3D-model references.
The sensor-board connector matrix and pin assignments remain unchanged; references in the source are file paths rather than connector references.
The battery connector type, contacts, accessibility, and unresolved pin order are unrelated to KiCad 3D-model path compatibility.
